name: guardrails
description: Stops pushes, PRs and raw commits you did not ask for, steers Bash to the right tools, and runs each project's own formatter on the file Claude just edited.

git.title: Git guard
git.description: Stop git push, gh pr create/ready/merge unless your last message asked for it, and raw git commit outside the commit skill.

shell.title: Shell guard
shell.description: Stop Bash commands your CLI rules forbid (CI polling, sed -i, grep, find) and scripts that write files instead of using Edit or Write.

project.title: Project tools
project.description: Run the project's formatter (Pint, sheath, vp fmt, Prettier) on each edited file, and apply its command rules (bun, Valet, artisan --no-interaction).
